C1322.title: Petya/NotPetya Leveraged LotL Tools for Mass Propagation
C1322.summary: In June 2017, NotPetya initially entered corporate networks through the compromised update process of the Ukrainian finance application M.E.Doc. It then obtained account credentials through credential dumping and used PsExec for remote execution and lateral propagation. The incident combined a compromised software supply chain with abuse of a legitimate administration tool, making it a prominent example of Living off the Land techniques amplifying an attack.
